Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper around a MultiPaxos specification. It adds type-correctness and consensus-oriented checking operators over the imported state from the underlying MultiPaxos module, and it instantiates a separate ConsensusMulti specification to compare the learned values against an abstract consensus interface. The file verifies that the MultiPaxos specification implies a type invariant, implies the instantiated consensus specification, and also implies two invariant-style properties: nontriviality and per-slot consistency. The comments note that some checks are intended only for very small constant instances because of state-space blowup, while simpler invariants can be checked on larger instances.
